title: Terminal
readme:
Welcome to my corner of the internet.

These files come from my actual about, projects, and now pages.
Blog files contain summaries; read the full posts on leodeng.dev/blog.

Start with cat about.txt. This is a real Linux shell, so you can
create files, write scripts, use pipes, and edit with vi.
galleryFile:
My photography, including planespotting.
Browse the gallery at https://leodeng.dev/gallery.
timeFile:
My Raspberry Pi gets time from GPS/PPS and serves Stratum 1 NTP at home.
The live clock is at https://leodeng.dev/time.
linuxIntro: A real Linux kernel and shell running in your browser. Try fastfetch, uname -a, or cat about.txt | head -n 5. You can write shell scripts and edit files with vi. My site files are in /home/leo.
linuxSize: Linux image: 5.17 MB. Welcome recordings, Fastfetch, emulator, and firmware add about 6 MB. Guest RAM: 64 MB.
linuxFailed: Linux could not start. Try booting again. Your browser needs WebAssembly support.
linuxHint: The downloaded image is saved in your browser and reused on future visits. Linux starts a fresh session each time; changes inside the guest are discarded when you stop or leave. Clearing site data or browser storage eviction removes the saved image.
linuxWelcome:
Welcome to my Linux corner.

This is Buildroot Linux with a real kernel and BusyBox shell.
You are logged in as leo, starting in /home/leo.

Try: ls projects/
Try: cat projects/llmgps.txt
Try: ls blog/
Try: cat voice/README.txt
Try: play voice/welcome.mp3
Try: afplay voice/welcome-chinese.mp3
Try: fastfetch
Try: uname -a

My welcome recordings are in voice/, downloaded with Linux.
play and afplay use your browser to play these local files.
Give play or afplay a file path. Use stop to stop playback.
Guest networking is disconnected. The Linux image stays saved
in your browser; session changes are discarded when you leave.
linuxConsent: Download about 11 MB to run Linux, including both welcome recordings? I will save everything in your browser for future visits.
linuxCached: Linux and both welcome recordings are saved in this browser. Starting uses the saved files.
linuxCacheUnavailable: Your browser could not save the full download. Linux still runs, but another visit may ask you to download again.
voiceReadme:
Both welcome recordings are downloaded with Linux and saved in your browser.
Play a recording by giving its file path:
play voice/welcome.mp3
afplay voice/welcome-chinese.mp3
From this folder, use play welcome.mp3.
Use stop to stop playback.
audioMissing: Audio file not found. Use a file path, for example play voice/welcome.mp3.
audioFailed: Audio could not play. Use WAV, MP3, OGG, M4A, or WebM audio under 10 MB.
voiceIntro: Listen in English or Chinese. Both recordings are included when you download Linux.
audioBlocked: Playback blocked. Allow audio for this site and try again.
